meta.title: Status Bar
meta.description: A living terminal strip for DeepSeek Harness, shown either docked under the composer or as a floating card you can drag anywhere (one at a time): the running model with its family mark, a rotating status phrase (editable - any number of your own lines), a token-flow lane - beads, heartbeat, water, a typing terminal line or highway traffic that grows with tok/s - a tok/s tachometer, an optional context-window gauge, the agent's checklist as step boxes, and real turns, token split, cache-hit and context figures. Twelve palettes, a click wave, and a settings page under Plugins.
